pr.body:
Team Compare public links and iframes can now restrict the catalog to a competition or lock one explicit season, while Studio retains the full organization catalog. Studio exports one of three scopes without pinning teams and preserves it across reload/language changes; changing organization clears it.

Server validates organization/competition/season/group/phase ownership before data reads and cache access, with cache separation and no replacement season for invalid/empty selections. Existing unrestricted and preselection URLs remain compatible. Documentation includes verified PHM Cup 2026-2027 UUIDs.

Validation: full Node test suite and Team Compare Playwright browser QA, including API malformed/foreign/conflicting IDs, warm cache, all three export scopes, Studio reload/reset, new browser context, locked division/language selection, empty season and HMS outage. No Game Center, statistics calculations or other widget behavior changed. Production deployment requested by the user.
